names.gloss: (Αἴγυπτος, the Greek name of the land; Hebrew Miṣrayim)

greek: καὶ εἰσήκουσεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν στεναγμὸν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ θεὸς τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ τῆς πρὸς Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ.
hint: God hears their groaning and remembers his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

notes.text: First a disposition of property by will, then an arrangement between two parties, a covenant, last.
The article repeated over a phrase: his covenant, the one toward Abraham.

reading: and [[hearkened|hearkened / gave ear to, heard, hearkened to / gave heed to|εἰσακούω]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] [[the sighing|the sighing / groaning / moaning|στεναγμός]] of them, and [[reminded himself of|reminded himself of, called to mind / remembered, bethought himself of, bore in mind / did not forget, mentioned / made mention of|μιμνήσκομαι]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] [[of the disposition|of the disposition of property by will, of the will / testament, of the arrangement between two parties, of the covenant|διαθήκη]] of him, of the one [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Αβρααμ]] and [[name:Ισαακ]] and [[name:Ιακωβ]].

names.gloss: (Αβρααμ, from Hebrew ʾAbrāhām, which the Hebrew of Genesis 17:5 hears in ʾab hămôn gôyim, "father of a multitude of nations")
(Ιακωβ, from Hebrew Yaʿăqōb, which the Hebrew of Genesis 25:26 hears in ʿāqēb, "heel")

greek: καὶ ἐπεῖδεν ὁ θεὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐγνώσθη αὐτοῖς.
hint: God looks upon the sons of Israel, and is made known to them; the Hebrew says God knew.

notes.text: And he was made known to them, the passive: the Hebrew has wayyēdaʿ ʾĕlōhîm, and God knew.

reading: and [[oversaw|oversaw / observed / surveyed, watched over / observed / took notice of, visited, looked upon / viewed / beheld, looked out / chose|ἐφοράω]] [[the God|he who is God definitively, the one the article marks out, the known and the only|θεός]] the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] and [[was learned to know|was learned to know / perceived / marked / learned, was discerned / distinguished, was observed / formed a judgment on, was judged / thought, was pronounced, was judged / determined / decreed that|γινώσκω]] to them.
